report: No defects found in the publication metadata. The README, COPY-MANIFEST.json, and SOURCE-ID-MAP.json keep source attribution separate from current-Rust compatibility: the 20 retained IDs/names and 24 legacy specimens are not current Rust passes, and the shared parser/checker/frontend/compiler/K2 plus invoice/reserve source calls are not all-20 compatibility. Each explicit family mapping remains UNLOCATED only within the recorded bounded literal ID/name search. The invoice-partial K6 receipt remains a separate narrow fabricated-context observation, not F03 and not ledger truth. The README accurately records the rejected original operator-ready metadata, the exact three-field correction, root qualification of source attribution only, frozen-hash ID namespacing for all 28 review IDs, and that corrected coverage preserves the original 26-ID coverage rather than a new full-source read. Captured HEAD and clean state remain historical observation only. This audit makes no independent byte-hash, exhaustive-source, implementation, security, compatibility, proof, native-authority, operator, Preview, Preprod, or ledger claim.
